questions.q: In which year did Montenegro become independent from Serbia?
questions.why: A referendum narrowly approved it.

questions.q: Which old royal capital is home to the Cetinje Monastery?
questions.why: It is still the 'old royal capital'.

questions.q: Which king ruled Montenegro until 1918?
questions.why: He was called the 'father-in-law of Europe'.

questions.q: At which 1878 congress was Montenegro recognised as independent?
questions.why: It gained land and a coastline.

questions.q: Which country did Montenegro join in 1918?
questions.a: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes
questions.why: Its king was deposed.

questions.q: Which dynasty ruled Montenegro from 1696?
questions.why: Its early rulers were prince-bishops.

questions.q: Which medieval state was a forerunner of Montenegro?
questions.why: It became Zeta later.

questions.q: Which ancient Roman city near Podgorica gave its name to Duklja?
questions.why: Its ruins are outside the city.

questions.q: What was Podgorica called from 1946 to 1992?
questions.why: It was named after Josip Broz Tito.

questions.q: Which bridge over the Tara canyon was blown up in the Second World War and rebuilt?
questions.why: It was 150 m above the river.

questions.q: What is the capital of Montenegro?
questions.why: It was called Titograd in Yugoslav times.

questions.q: Which old Venetian town in a fjord-like bay is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Its walls climb up the mountain.

questions.q: Which bay is Montenegro's most famous landscape?
questions.why: It looks like a fjord.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Montenegro's coast?
questions.why: Budva is its busiest resort.

questions.q: Which tiny island town is now a luxury resort?
questions.why: It is joined to the mainland by a causeway.

questions.q: Which lake on the Albanian border is the largest in the Balkans?
questions.why: It is famous for its birds.

questions.q: Which national park has the deep Tara River canyon?
questions.why: The canyon is Europe's deepest.

questions.q: Which island church in the Bay of Kotor was built on an artificial islet?
questions.why: Sailors dropped stones to build the islet.

questions.q: Which coastal town has a long sandy beach near Albania?
questions.why: Its Velika Plaža is about 13 km long.

questions.q: Which monastery is built into a cliff high above the Bjelopavlići plain?
questions.why: It is a major pilgrimage site.

questions.q: Which national park has one of Europe's last rainforests?
questions.why: It has a glacial lake.

questions.q: Which town on the bay is famous for Baroque palaces of sea captains?
questions.why: It once had its own fleet.

questions.q: Which mountain holds Njegoš's mausoleum?
questions.why: It is reached by 461 steps.

questions.q: Which smoked ham from the village of Njeguši is a speciality?
questions.why: It is smoked over beech wood.

questions.q: What is Montenegro's highest peak?
questions.why: It is in the Prokletije range.

questions.q: Which sport has Montenegro excelled in with Olympic medals?
questions.why: Its women's handball team won silver in 2012.

questions.q: Which prince-bishop wrote the epic 'The Mountain Wreath'?
questions.why: His mausoleum is on Mount Lovćen.

questions.q: In which year did Montenegro join NATO?
questions.why: It was the 29th member.

questions.q: Which currency does Montenegro use, without being in the eurozone?
questions.why: It adopted the Deutsche Mark first.

questions.q: What does 'Montenegro' mean?
questions.why: In Montenegrin it is Crna Gora.
